scope: one shared host; exploratory synthetic workloads

experiment_plan.question: Does the opt-in Q4_K VNNI GEMV kernel improve resident CPU inference on this host without numerical changes?

primary_model.name: Qwen3-0.6B-Q4_K_M
primary_model.selection_reason: Hidden width 1024 permits Q4_K weights throughout more projections; chosen before whole-model candidate measurements. SmolLM2 hidden width 576 causes most projections to use other quantizations; separate diagnostic attributed only about 6 percent of its decode operator time to Q4_K and is perturbed by profiling.

experiment_plan.tuning: Select baseline threads from 1/2/4/8 physical cores and flash attention on/off by lowest primary resident-total median; same configuration for candidate and all workloads.
experiment_plan.correctness: Kernel fixtures bitwise equality; full vocabulary at 17 positions per workload at atol=rtol=1e-5 with identical greedy choices.
experiment_plan.exploratory_acceptance: Primary median baseline/candidate resident-total ratio >=1.20, paired bootstrap95 lower bound >1, no additional-workload total slowdown >5 percent. Correctness required. Not sufficient for a general product claim.
experiment_plan.limitations: Same binary includes original arithmetic and candidate; no pristine-upstream binary comparison. Synthetic fixed tokens; no sampling. Single shared laptop; dynamic frequencies and background load.
